description.ja: ■全高約125mm。シリーズ最小サイズの可愛らしいシスター。
description.en: • Overall height approximately 125mm. The smallest cute sister in the series.

description.ja: ■ボディの構造を新規で開発。ペタッと地面に座るポーズでのディスプレイが楽しめる。
description.en: • Newly developed body structure. You can enjoy the display while sitting on the ground.

description.ja: ■胴体を上下に分割することで体をひねるような動きが可能。
description.en: • By dividing the torso into upper and lower parts, it is possible to twist the body.

description.ja: ■黒ウサギをイメージしたアーマーが付属。
description.en: • Comes with armor inspired by a black rabbit.

description.ja: ■複数パーツを使用したカラフルなウサミミ型カチューシャが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a colorful rabbit ear headband that uses multiple parts.

description.ja: ■フェイスパーツは「通常」「ムス顔」「叫び」の３種から付け替え可能。ポージングに合わせた表情を楽しめる。
description.en: • Face parts can be changed from three types: "normal ", " musical face ", and " screaming". You can enjoy the expressions that match the poses.

description.ja: ■「30MS SIS-T00 リリネル[カラーA]」（別売り）と隣り合わせで並べることで、交わる視線を演出できる。
description.en: • By lining it up next to "30MS SIS-T00 Lilinel [Color A]" (sold separately), you can create an intersecting line of sight.

description.ja: ■「30MS SIS-T00 リリネル[カラーA]」(別売り）の武装を取り付けることでフル装備状態のカスタマイズが可能！
description.en: • You can customize the fully equipped state by attaching the armament of "30MS SIS-T00 Lilinel [Color A]" (sold separately)!

accessories.ja: 前髪パーツ(リリネル(別売り)付属ヘッドギア装着用)×1
accessories.en: Bangs parts (for attaching headgear included with Lilinel (sold separately)) x 1
